tools.name: plan_release
tools.description: Calculate a dated music-release milestone checklist counted backward and forward from a target release date (asset lock, metadata and split sheets, distributor upload window, DSP editorial pitch deadline, pre-save, content and outreach windows, royalty registrations, release day, and 30-day post-release follow-through). Use when the user provides a target release date (YYYY-MM-DD) and wants a dated release timeline. Limitations: Read-only calculation only; does not schedule posts, upload files, or submit anything to DSPs or distributors.

release_date.description: Target release date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

today.description: Optional reference current date in YYYY-MM-DD format used to evaluate whether milestones are on_track, tight, or at_risk.

tools.name: check_release_readiness
tools.description: Evaluate six self-reported music-release readiness checkpoints (master, artwork, metadata, rights, distribution, promotion) and return a readiness score, overall status (checklist_complete, needs_action, or needs_confirmation), and concrete next actions. Use when the user asks whether a release is ready or wants to audit release preparation across the six checkpoints. Limitations: Read-only evaluation of user-reported statuses only; does not inspect audio files, verify legal clearances, or check external distributor accounts.

master.description: Self-reported status of the final audio master.

artwork.description: Self-reported status of the cover artwork.

metadata.description: Self-reported status of track metadata, credits, and identifiers (ISRC/UPC).

rights.description: Self-reported status of split sheets, sample clearances, and licenses.

distribution.description: Self-reported status of distributor delivery and acceptance.

promotion.description: Self-reported status of promotional assets, pitches, and rollout plan.

tools.name: get_epk_outline
tools.description: Return a structured Electronic Press Kit (EPK) section outline, required proof points, call-to-action guidance, storyline beats, and bio word-count targets tailored to a specific industry audience (general, booking, partnerships, festival, or release_campaign). Use when the user asks for an EPK outline or press kit structure for a target reader. Limitations: Read-only template scaffold only; does not invent artist facts, shows, or press quotes and does not publish or send an EPK.

audience.description: Target audience for the EPK outline.
